title: Comments and markup UI: panel, badge, popup, tools
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-app --features ui,pdfium; A-15, A-18, A-19 and A-24 work on real documents in all four theme/control combinations; A-32 (XFDF import/export and shared-folder review) is T-0246.
notes: Shell half of the comments pair per ADR 0012; opens only after the T-0230 library is verified and its claim is released. Serves acceptance items A-15 (Comments rail with real count badge), A-18 (highlight from a text selection), A-19 (comment note with thread popup, author, time, menu: reply/resolve/edit/delete), A-24 (Comment tool and markup set) and A-32 (Comment & Review, XFDF import/export) from docs/design/FEATURE_ACCEPTANCE.md. Adds the Comments rail entry and panel with the real annotation count, note and highlight tools through the command bar, the annotation popup with reply/resolve/edit/delete, and XFDF import/export, calling the T-0230 API and not changing its semantics. A-11 shared-folder review remains the app lane's own later work. The three annotation feature-matrix rows become `verified` only when this task lands; until then they stay `library` after T-0230. The app lane runs one task at a time, so T-0221 is an implicit ordering constraint, not a formal dependency. Demo capture flags removed; captures must open a real annotated file, not inject sample content. A stale main-canvas raster (thumbnail showed the annotation, canvas did not) is fixed with a regression test before verification.
